text.p: The following are the leading stories in the Maltese press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Opposition says proposed new system of indirect taxation is complicated and unfair; it will replace VAT with excise duties and tax on products.
- Police will strictly enforce legislation on letting off noisy fireworks at village religious feasts on weekends, barring them within 200 metres (yards) of residential areas.
- Heroin seized on Tuesday worth some 600,000 Malta pounds (about $1.7 million).
